_comment: Base-engine bootstrap spec for the Model Optimizer. __MODEL_BUCKET__ is replaced by deploy.sh, which uploads this to s3://<bucket>/optimizer-bootstrap/spec.json and points the optimizer at it via OPTIMIZER_BOOTSTRAP_URI. On startup the optimizer builds any missing <model>_stable/1/model.plan from the exported ONNX. input_profiles/max batch match source/triton/model_repository/<model>_stable/config.pbtxt and source/deployment/model_deployer.py::_MODEL_INPUT_PROFILES. Wide & Deep (widedeep_segment_activator) is intentionally absent: it is now rule-based (no Triton/TensorRT model) — see source/containers/widedeep_segment_activator/app.py.
